name: epp-360
description: OctoBus package for 360 Enterprise Endpoint Protection Platform (360 EPP v10.0.0.08331). Provides terminal management, alarm query, virus scan stats, and vulnerability fix stats APIs.

Qihoo360_EPP.Qihoo360_EPP/ListTerminals.name: list-terminals
Qihoo360_EPP.Qihoo360_EPP/ListTerminals.description: 查询 360 EPP 终端列表，支持分页和关键词搜索

Qihoo360_EPP.Qihoo360_EPP/ListAlarms.name: list-alarms
Qihoo360_EPP.Qihoo360_EPP/ListAlarms.description: 查询 360 EPP 告警日志列表

Qihoo360_EPP.Qihoo360_EPP/GetVirusStats.name: get-virus-stats
Qihoo360_EPP.Qihoo360_EPP/GetVirusStats.description: 获取病毒扫描统计数据

Qihoo360_EPP.Qihoo360_EPP/GetLeakFixStat.name: get-leakfix-stats
Qihoo360_EPP.Qihoo360_EPP/GetLeakFixStat.description: 获取漏洞修复统计数据

Qihoo360_EPP.Qihoo360_EPP/GetTerminalHar.name: get-terminal-hardware
Qihoo360_EPP.Qihoo360_EPP/GetTerminalHar.description: 获取终端硬件配置信息
